independent_crosscheck.polynomial_method: Generic induced-forest recurrence P(G)=P(G-v)+zP(G-N[v]), memoized on vertex masks; not the producer's independent-subset polynomial accumulator.
independent_crosscheck.literal_subset_checks: For every selected leaf tag, enumerated independent k-sets in H to count actual addable vertices E and independent (k+1)-sets meeting W at least twice to count C once per upper set.

conclusion_boundary: These checks validate the finite sampled claim and its recorded arithmetic only. The seeded labeled sample is not exhaustive and supplies neither a proof nor a counterexample to the universal lower-region aggregate or CT_x inequality.
